Skanska USA Civil Northeast, part of Skanska AB
, said on Tuesday that it won a $271.2M firm-fixed-price contract to build a homeport pier for the U.S. Coast Guard’s Offshore Patrol Cutters.
The project will use a design-bid-build approach and will be carried out at Naval Station Newport in Newport, Rhode Island.
The contract includes the base work and four options, bringing the maximum value to $271.2M.
The work is expected to be completed by March 2030.
The full $271.2M is being obligated at award, funded through fiscal 2022 Major Acquisition Systems Infrastructure and fiscal 2025 OBBBA Department of Homeland Security/Coast Guard funds.
However, of the amount, $51.1M will expire at the end of the current fiscal year, while the remaining funds will not expire at fiscal year-end.
Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command is the contracting activity.

title: Skanska's unit wins $271M U.S. Coast Guard offshore patrol contract
